description: Rewire the runtime decision path to be fully rule-based BEFORE deleting the ML files, so the system stays importable and testable at every step. Replace the ensemble-derived confidence in SignalGenerator with a rules-derived confidence (the same synthetic-confidence approach backtest.py already uses via momentum magnitude), remove the RL agent usage, and remove the RL-dependent smart-exit layer from main.py. This is the biggest rewiring job and must preserve the momentum/RSI/structure/session/regime/risk pipeline and the unchanged CSV signal contract. Do this feature and FEAT-003 (deletions) together conceptually, but land the rewiring first so nothing that remains imports the deleted modules.
steps: In python_bridge/strategies/signal_generator.py: remove 'from models.ensemble import EnsembleManager' and 'from models.rl_agent import RLAgent, PositionState, ExitAction' (lines ~25-26) and the MODEL_DIR/RLConfig/SmartExitConfig imports from config.settings that are no longer used (line ~21). Keep SignalConfig, DataConfig, SessionConfig, SpreadFilterConfig, AdaptiveMomentumConfig, PriceStructureConfig, FVGConfig, LiquiditySweepConfig, AutoOptimizerConfig.

In SignalGenerator.__init__ (line ~102-107): remove 'self.ensemble = EnsembleManager()' and 'self._rl_agent = RLAgent(RLConfig())'. Keep risk_manager, regime_detector, _open_positions, _auto_optimizer, _active_position, etc.

Add a rules-derived confidence helper mirroring backtest.py compute_momentum_magnitude: confidence = 0.2 + 0.7*(1 - exp(-abs_momentum_diff/1.5)), capped at 0.95, where abs_momentum_diff is |close[-1] - close[-lookback]| over the same momentum window the generator already computes. Use momentum_prices (M1 if available). This becomes the base 'timing_confidence'.

Remove the models_loaded gate (lines ~1037-1050) and the checkpoint-dir fallback entirely. The generator should never HOLD due to missing models; it proceeds based on momentum/RSI as backtest.py does.

Replace the ensemble prediction block (lines ~1210-1226): delete 'prediction = self.ensemble.predict(features)' and the probabilities/agreement extraction. Set base timing_confidence from the new rules-derived helper. Keep all subsequent confidence adjustments unchanged (HTF penalty 5, S/R 5b, RSI exhaustion 5c, price structure 5d, DXY 5e, FVG/liquidity boosts, session multiplier).
In the TradeSignal construction (line ~912): change model_name from 'ensemble' to 'momentum' so the CSV signal contract stays intact with a rule-based label.

Rewrite update_from_execution (lines ~1497-1560): keep self.risk_manager.close_trade(trade_id, pnl); remove the ensemble.update_weights call and the entire RL PositionState/state_from_position/compute_reward/store_transition/train_step block. Preserve the AutoOptimizer feedback path (trade context recording happens in main.py; ensure update_from_execution no longer references RL). Keep _open_positions cleanup (del self._open_positions[trade_id]).

Remove register_open_position's RL-specific fields if they are only used by RL, OR keep the dict but drop RL-only keys; ensure no remaining code reads them. The position tracking used by main.py smart_exits will be removed in the main.py step below, so simplify accordingly.

In python_bridge/main.py: remove imports 'from models.ensemble import EnsembleManager' (line ~42) and 'from training.auto_retrain import AutoRetrainer'; remove 'from strategies.smart_exits import SmartExitManager, ExitDecision'; prune settings import of TransformerConfig, LSTMConfig, EnsembleConfig, RLConfig, RetrainConfig, MODEL_DIR (line ~31-35) keeping MainConfig, DataConfig, SignalConfig, RiskConfig, MultiTimeframeConfig, NewsFilterConfig, MultiPairConfig, DashboardConfig, AutoOptimizerConfig, LOG_DIR.

In main.py __init__: delete self.smart_exits, self.auto_retrainer, and the _load_models() call. Remove the _load_models method (lines ~205-213). Delete the SentimentAnalyzer/AlternativeDataFetcher instantiation (see FEAT-003 for the file deletions; here just stop constructing them and remove their imports). Keep signal_generator, bridge, multi_tf, news_filter, multi_pair_config, auto_optimizer, performance_tracker, dashboard_renderer, confirmation poller.

In main.py run_cycle: remove the AUTO-RETRAIN CHECK block (step 0a) and the entire SMART EXITS block (step 10b, lines ~540-620 including 'from models.rl_agent import PositionState'). Keep news filter, data fetch, feature compute, signal generation (step 9), signal write (step 10), heartbeat, and dashboard rendering. The signal_generator.generate_signal call no longer needs a valid model feature input; pass what it still requires (prices, atr, current_price, adx_series, htf_bias, cross_pair_info, prices_m1) and drop the ensemble 'features' sequence argument if generate_signal no longer uses it.

In python_bridge/main_multi.py: remove MODEL_DIR from the config.settings import (line ~25). It subclasses PythonMLBridge so it inherits the rewired behavior; confirm it imports nothing else ML-related.

In python_bridge/data/market_data.py: it imports MODEL_DIR and writes normalization_stats.json there (lines ~21, 296-308). Since MODEL_DIR is being removed, repoint normalization stats to a runtime dir (e.g. a new NORM_STATS_DIR or reuse LOG_DIR) OR remove the normalization-stats persistence if it was only used by the ML training/inference path. Verify nothing in the retained rule-based path depends on normalization_stats.json before removing it; if unused at runtime by backtest.py/signal_generator, remove the read/write.

In python_bridge/dashboard/performance_tracker.py: update the per-model references (lines ~32, 405, 451) from ['transformer','lstm','gradient_boost','ensemble'] to a rule-based label set (e.g. ['momentum']) so dashboard stats reflect the simplified system.

After rewiring, run an offline import + syntax check from workspace root: 'cd python_bridge && python -c "import ast,glob; [ast.parse(open(f).read()) for f in glob.glob(\'**/*.py\', recursive=True)]"' and confirm no SyntaxError. Then confirm signal_generator, main, main_multi import without pulling models.* (they will still exist until FEAT-003, but must no longer be imported).
acceptance_criteria: grep for 'models.ensemble', 'models.rl_agent', 'EnsembleManager', 'RLAgent', 'PositionState', 'ExitAction' in signal_generator.py, main.py, main_multi.py, smart_exits usage returns zero matches in the runtime path (models/ dir itself still present until FEAT-003).
SignalGenerator.generate_signal derives confidence from momentum magnitude (rules-based), never from a model prediction, and never HOLDs due to missing model checkpoints.
The TradeSignal CSV row still has 9 fields in the exact order timestamp,symbol,action,confidence,sl_pips,tp_pips,lot_size,model_name,regime with model_name='momentum'.
main.py run_cycle contains no auto-retrain or RL smart-exit logic and constructs no ensemble/RL/smart-exit objects.
AST parse of all python_bridge/**/*.py succeeds with no SyntaxError.

A synthetic offline smoke test: construct SignalGenerator(), call generate_signal on a hand-built OHLCV DataFrame (enough bars for momentum+RSI), and get a TradeSignal (BUY/SELL/HOLD) back without importing any models.* module.
verification: cd python_bridge && python -c "import ast,glob; [ast.parse(open(f).read()) for f in glob.glob('**/*.py', recursive=True)]; print('AST OK')"
cd python_bridge && python -c "import sys; import strategies.signal_generator as sg; assert 'ensemble' not in [n for n in dir(sg.SignalGenerator())]; print('no ensemble attr')"
cd python_bridge && python -m pytest tests/test_backtester.py tests/test_auto_optimizer.py -v
findings:
Rewired the runtime decision path to be fully rule-based; no ML files deleted yet (that is FEAT-003), so the package stays importable.

signal_generator.py: removed 'from models.ensemble import EnsembleManager' and 'from models.rl_agent import RLAgent, PositionState, ExitAction'; dropped RLConfig/SmartExitConfig/MODEL_DIR from the config.settings import. __init__ no longer constructs self.ensemble or self._rl_agent (kept risk_manager, regime_detector, _open_positions, _auto_optimizer, _active_position). Added _compute_momentum_magnitude() mirroring backtest.py: confidence = 0.2 + 0.7*(1 - exp(-abs_diff/1.5)), capped 0.95, abs_diff = |close[-1] - close[-(lookback+1)]| over data_config.momentum_lookback on momentum_prices (M1 when available). Removed the models_loaded/checkpoint HOLD gate entirely. Replaced the ensemble prediction block: base timing_confidence now comes from _compute_momentum_magnitude; all downstream confidence adjustments (HTF, S/R, RSI exhaustion, price structure, DXY, FVG/liquidity, session multiplier) unchanged. Removed the individual_preds/top_model block; TradeSignal model_name is 'momentum' (both hold_signal and the emitted signal). Made generate_signal's 'features' arg optional (unused, kept for interface compat). Rewrote update_from_execution to only call risk_manager.close_trade + clean up _open_positions (no ensemble.update_weights, no RL). Simplified register_open_position to lightweight bookkeeping.

main.py: removed imports of EnsembleManager, SmartExitManager/ExitDecision, AutoRetrainer, SentimentAnalyzer, AlternativeDataFetcher; pruned settings import to MainConfig, DataConfig, SignalConfig, RiskConfig, MultiTimeframeConfig, NewsFilterConfig, MultiPairConfig, DashboardConfig, AutoOptimizerConfig, LOG_DIR (dropped TransformerConfig/LSTMConfig/EnsembleConfig/SmartExitConfig/RLConfig/RetrainConfig/MODEL_DIR). __init__ no longer builds self.sentiment/self.alt_data/self.smart_exits/self.auto_retrainer and no longer calls _load_models; removed the _load_models method and the ML/RL logging lines. run_cycle: removed the AUTO-RETRAIN block (step 0a) and the entire SMART EXITS block (step 10b, incl. 'from models.rl_agent import PositionState'); removed the model-input sequence fetch (get_latest_features) and dropped the features= arg from generate_signal; vix_level now hardcoded None (alt-data removed).

main_multi.py: dropped MODEL_DIR from the config.settings import.

market_data.py: replaced MODEL_DIR import with LOG_DIR and added NORM_STATS_DIR=LOG_DIR; normalization_stats.json now read/written under the runtime log dir (the rule-based path does not consume it; helpers retained for optional offline analysis).

performance_tracker.py: per-model label set changed from ['transformer','lstm','gradient_boost','ensemble'] to ['momentum']; updated the TradeRecord.model comment and get_model_stats docstring.

VERIFICATION (offline sandbox, no pandas/numpy/ta/torch; python at /root/.pyenv/versions/3.11.15/bin/python): (1) AST parse of all python_bridge/**/*.py => 'AST OK', no SyntaxError. (2) py_compile of signal_generator.py and main.py => OK. (3) grep for models.ensemble/models.rl_agent/EnsembleManager/RLAgent/PositionState/ExitAction/MODEL_DIR/SmartExit/AutoRetrainer in signal_generator.py, main.py, main_multi.py => zero matches; no 'from/import models' in the rewired files. (4) tests/test_auto_optimizer.py 41/41 passed; tests/test_dashboard.py 77/77 passed. CSV contract preserved: to_csv_row unchanged (9 fields), model_name='momentum'. NOTE: the acceptance-criteria synthetic SignalGenerator smoke test and test_backtester.py could NOT be executed here because numpy/pandas are not installed and cannot be installed (confirmed: 'import numpy' -> ModuleNotFoundError); the import of strategies.signal_generator fails ONLY on numpy, never on models.*, proving the ML modules are no longer imported. Code is written to run correctly under a real pandas/numpy environment.
